detail_text: This notice was posted to identify sources that can manufacture NSN 5998-01-586-0043 and are interested in quoting a solicitation. This notice was posted for the purpose of market research only and is not a Request for Proposal (RFP) . Please review the NSN below and provide any sources that may be able to manufacture the item. The sources that are currently approved to manufacture this Circuit Card Assembly are listed below. If you are interested in this requirement, please complete the attached Market Research Questionnaire. All information should be submitted to the Contract Specialist, Carrolline Kelly, at Carrolline.Kelly@dla.mil no later than March 27th, 2026. The approved sources and part numbers are listed below: NSN: 5998-01-586-0043 Description: Circuit Card Assembly Approved Sources and Part Numbers: Johnson Controls Navy Systems, LLC (CAGE 66935) P/N 025-41888-000 Hersey Measurement Co Div of Miller (CAGE 09550) P/N 60380G524N REV GG AMC: 3 AMSC: D No data is available. An alternate offeror is required to provide a complete data package including data for the approved and alternate part for evaluation.
